meta.name: db-redis
meta.description: Inspect Redis instances configured in .env (DB_REDIS_N_*). Use when the user asks to read keys, check cache state, list keys by pattern, or query info/dbsize on a Redis server. Picks connection by label (e.g. 'cache-dev', 'queue-prod') or numeric index. Read-only in v1 — no SET/DEL/FLUSH exposed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查 Redis 缓存状态和键值
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要查看 Redis 实例中的数据或状态
copy.tagline_en: Inspect Redis cache state and keys
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to check Redis instance data or status

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以检查你在 .env 文件中配置的 Redis 实例。它能列出所有连接、进行健康检查、按模式列出键（使用 SCAN 而非 KEYS）、读取单个键（自动识别类型并返回 TTL）、查看服务器信息和数据库大小。所有操作均为只读。
howto.when: 当你要求查看 Redis 键、检查缓存状态、按模式列出键或查询服务器信息时触发。

say.text: 帮我列出 Redis 实例 cache-dev 的所有键
检查 Redis 缓存状态
say.note: Claude 会执行健康检查（PING）并报告 RTT。

say.text: 读取 Redis 中 user:123 的值
say.note: Claude 会返回该键的值、类型和 TTL。

howto.what_en: Claude can inspect Redis instances configured in .env. It can list connections, health-check (PING), list keys by pattern (using SCAN), read a single key (auto-detects type, includes TTL), get server info, and get database size. All operations are read-only.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to read Redis keys, check cache state, list keys by pattern, or query server info.

say_en.text: List all keys in Redis instance cache-dev
say_en.note: Claude scans and returns the key list (up to MAX_ROWS).
Claude runs a PING and reports RTT.

say_en.text: Read the value of user:123 in Redis
say_en.note: Claude returns the value, type, and TTL.
